results.title: 'Sopranos' actor Vincent Pastore, known for playing mobsters and tough guys, dead at 80
results.description: NEW YORK — Vincent Pastore, a veteran actor who played mobsters and tough guys, and was best known for portraying Salvatore “Big Pussy” Bonpensiero on “The Sopranos,” has died. He was 80.

results.title: #SHOWBIZ: Ariana Grande withdraws from London musical, seeks to 'step back'
results.description: WASHINGTON: Pop star Ariana Grande has dropped out of what would have been her debut appearance in London's West End, the show's producers said on Sunday, as a representative for the singer said she wants to take a “step back” from the public eye.
